# Horvvalle Atelier

> Luxury fashion brand and bespoke tailoring atelier based in Baku, Azerbaijan. Offering ready-to-wear premium men's garments, custom made-to-measure tailoring, and an interactive 3D live print studio.

## Core Capabilities & Services

- **Bespoke Atelier Tailoring**: Garments crafted to individual customer measurements (height, weight, body proportions) using premium combed cotton, 3-thread heavyweight fleece (380 GSM), and luxury linen.
- **3D Interactive Custom Studio**: Real-time 3D canvas allowing customers to upload custom graphics, brand logos, or text onto premium t-shirts and apparel with industrial DTF thermal transfer.
- **Ready-to-Wear Luxury Collections**:
  - Classic & Vintage Heavyweight Polos (Angelus, McLaren Racing editions)
  - 3-Thread Oversized Heavyweight Hoodies & Sweatshirts
  - Tailored Chino & Smart Classic Trousers
  - Snapback Caps & Eco Canvas Tote Bags
- **Fast Delivery & Guarantee**: 24-hour free delivery across Baku; nationwide shipping across Azerbaijan within 2-3 business days. 14-day hassle-free return and exchange guarantee.
- **Secure Payments**: Apple Pay, Google Pay, Visa, Mastercard, and Cash on Delivery / Mobile POS.

## Key Links & Endpoints

- [Home Page](https://horvvalle.com/): Official flagship store, brand philosophy, and featured drops.
- [Collections](https://horvvalle.com/collections): Browse all products filtered by category (koynek, hudi, salvar, aksesuar) and gender.
- [3D Custom Studio](https://horvvalle.com/studio): Interactive custom apparel designer with 3D model preview.
- [Order Tracking](https://horvvalle.com/track): Real-time shipment status lookup by order code (e.g. HV-XXXX).
- [Checkout](https://horvvalle.com/checkout): Seamless checkout with multi-currency (AZN, USD, EUR) and instant payment methods.
- [Privacy Policy](https://horvvalle.com/privacy): Personal data protection, encryption, and GDPR compliance.
- [Terms of Service](https://horvvalle.com/terms): Official terms, return policy, delivery conditions, and customer rights.
